title: Prepare the unsent AURA reception dossier for the published electrochemical unit profile
commitMessage: docs: prepare AURA electrochemical reception dossier from verified Math delivery

contribution.summary: Prepare a Math-owned, unsent AURA reception dossier for A2-W02-C01-U-N from the durable RS177 readback and exact local package identities.
contribution.value: Record the three exact package/archive/DLL identities, six opt-in unit IDs, 58/14 catalogue preservation, AURA ownership boundaries, rollback expectations and the recipient-side independent verification recipe. The dossier remains draft with transmission=none.
debtChanges: RS177 succeeded at attempt 001 after one pre-attempt workflow-refusal; firstPassSucceeded is false. The independent readback is acquired and must not be replayed.
Math has completed local publication and physical readback. AURA integration remains unverified and historical AURA reuse rights remain unestablished.
This run prepares but does not transmit an inter-agent request. It does not modify AURA, publish remotely, alter package bytes or reopen completed native product nodes.

RS178 first invocation refused pre-attempt because Files.ConvergeFromStaged received the 40-character Git blob SHA instead of the required 64-character content SHA-256. Corrected to the exact README content SHA-256; no attempt was allocated.

RS178 second invocation refused pre-attempt on target re-entry: Require.FileMissing rejected the exact installed MATH-XR-006 draft. Now accept only missing baseline or byte-identical staged targets; divergent contents still refuse. No allocated attempt.
contribution.nextAction: After durable success, provide the MATH-XR-006 draft to the owner for explicit transmission to the AURA owning agent; await AURA-side independent reception evidence before claiming adoption.
